tests.name: filter_empty

weaknesses.title: SETENV/plant is process-local across cubalc runs
weaknesses.detail: plant then dump in separate invocations sees zero keys. Same class as DOTENV. Forces seed/snap compound actions.

weaknesses.title: filter empty GREP overwrites VAL dump plate
weaknesses.detail: Failed filter writes empty bag to VAL; next filter sees no dump. Agents lose inventory on miss without separate DUMP plate.
weaknesses.repro: seed; filter NOPE; filter ROLE → no dump

weaknesses.title: GREP substring false friends on KEY=VAL
weaknesses.detail: filter ROLE matches ROLE=worker; also would match ROLE_EXTRA. No key-exact GREP.

weaknesses.title: WRITEENV empty prefix match writes 0-byte plate OK
weaknesses.detail: Silent empty snapshot; hard to tell intentional empty vs wrong prefix.

weaknesses.title: TRUNCATE grow zero-extends without content clear semantics doc
weaknesses.detail: Agents may expect clear-only; grow leaves NULs.

weaknesses.title: DUMPENV full dump can be huge; TRUNC flag rare
weaknesses.detail: Empty prefix inventories entire process env; agents may leak secrets into VAL plate.

workarounds: Use seed/snap for multi-step env plant+dump same process
Keep DUMP.txt separate from FILTER result plate
HASLINE for exact KEY=VAL; GREP only for needles
Always set narrow PREFIX before dump/save
language_gaps: Cross-run env plant persistence (or document only)
issues_faced: plant/dump across runs empty → seed/snap compound
